title: 11D Axis / 5D Door / Dual-Spiral Model — Conversation Recovery
status: primary project scaffold + conversation-developed physics analogies; not established M-theory
importance: A substantial 11D Axis model was buried inside long synthesis conversations rather than preserved as a named theory. The user-originated scaffold explicitly places lower material/mud layers in 1–4D, the Door/Axis at 5D, and sprouts/higher structure in 6–11D, with compactification language and upward/downward spirals.
primary_user_scaffold: Introduce M-theory as a comparison framework.
Treat the Door as an object at the 5D threshold.
Roots descend into mud/swamp/lower dimensions below the Door.
Sprouts extend above the Door through dimensions 6–11.
Higher structure is compactified/in-folded; lower structure is classical/surface/time-bound.
Tim/Axis is vertical; spirals climb toward Heaven/North-of-North; advanced-wave language belongs to the upper direction.
The Door is narrow and functions at every moment as a divider/threshold.

dual_spiral_structure.center: 5D Door/Axis acts as turning or classification threshold between the two trajectories
dual_spiral_structure.formal_project_abstraction: Let level l be an ordered project coordinate. A trajectory X(s) has dl/ds>0 on the ascending branch and dl/ds<0 on the descending branch; the Door is a guard surface g(X)=0 where the transition rule may change.
dual_spiral_structure.relation_to_axis_flow: Compatible with project Axis notation dX/ds=A(X,g), but the old conversation did not itself provide this differential equation.

safe_formalization: branch choice may be represented by sign/order parameter q(X)
door_as_hybrid_boundary.project_meaning: The Door is not merely a place; it is a rule that changes admissible states/trajectories.
door_as_hybrid_boundary.continuous_present_interpretation: Older conversation language says the narrow Door divides at every micro-moment; this is naturally modeled as an event-by-event guard/decision surface rather than as a literal extra spacetime coordinate.

established_spine: 11D supergravity is the low-energy limit associated with M-theory
a direct 11D -> 4D compactification with minimal supersymmetry naturally uses a 7-real-dimensional G2-holonomy internal space

m_theory_comparator.important_correction: The old assistant expansion said dimensions 6–11 are generically Calabi-Yau compactified and that the fifth dimension contains all possible timelines. Those are not standard M-theory statements. Calabi-Yau threefolds are canonical in 10D string -> 4D compactification; direct 11D -> 4D minimal-SUSY comparison points to G2 holonomy. 'All timelines in 5D' is project symbolism, not established higher-dimensional physics.
m_theory_comparator.boundary: The project's numbered layers can be retained as a symbolic/state-space taxonomy without claiming they are literal M-theory dimensions.
